text: Or, his heart was exalted and lifted vp.
Gre. many euils haue found vs.
Or, set vp an open schoole at Ierusalem.
Or, the lawes and rites of the strangers of the land.
Or, and they made Israel hide themselues in holes, in euery place of succour.
Gr. the kings commandement put him to death.
Or, that had circumcised their children.
